method: NAIVE and AS PUBLISHED. Written in one pass from ICA's web pages as read on 12 October 2026 -- administrative policy, not law. The writing-l4-rules skill was not available in the session. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: ICA web pages as read on 12 October 2026: 'Apply for Singapore Citizenship' (last updated 30 June 2026), 'Singapore Citizenship', 'Oath-taking for Minors' (29 June 2026), 'Apply for Permanent Residence' (13 March 2026), 'Apply for Long-Term Visit Pass' (08 April 2026), its spouse-of-a-Singapore-citizen page (06 April 2026), 'Pre-Marriage LTVP Assessment' (27 October 2025), and 'Renunciation' of Singapore citizenship (13 March 2026). No page states an effective date.

scope: SCOPED to a Singapore citizen's foreign spouse. Citizenship: the spouse category (2 years as a PR and 2 years married, citizen spouse sponsoring) and the adult-PR category (2 years as a PR, aged 21 and above); the outcome as eligibility to apply with a discretionary grant; the Singapore Citizenship Journey (ages 16 to 60); the fees and the 12-month processing time; the finding that the adult pages state no renunciation or oath requirement; the minor's ORAL (window 21 to 22, loss of citizenship on the 22nd birthday, no fee, a foreign citizenship renunciation certificate among the documents). PR: the spouse-of-a-citizen-or-PR category, no stated minimum period, the fees, the 5-year re-entry permit and 6-month processing time. LTVP: the spouse-of-a-citizen category, no guarantee, the fees, the processing times with and without the PMLA, the 1-year life of the PMLA letter, renewal at least 3 months before expiry. Not encoded: assessment factors, LTVP+ requirements, LTVP validity, National Service, the Work Permit holder's pre-marriage approval, other categories, documents, payment methods. The statutory tests (Constitution Arts 123, 126, 128; Immigration Act 1959 s 10, s 55) are left to their rows.
